shared_file_insertions.inserted_text: **生成关系的解释必要性 / Generative explanatory necessity, 8 October 2026.** [首轮研究](theories/shengsheng-buxi-generative-existence/unified-2026-10-05/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md)区分必要关系内容、解释形成与本体优先。**17项新 Lean 定理／42项含继承审计通过**：完整有限端点答案可恢复一步关系；仅可行性不足；整体历史约束在粗配置上可能不可组合，保留历史可恢复精确表示。[论证、实质自我反审与原始来源](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY-INTEGRATION.md)保留同内容的整体约束对手。 / The finite-query study is complete at its declared scope; universal indispensability remains open. Next compare the explanatory direction of global constraints and formative dependence on an independently fixed target. No new normative warrant or unique truth-generator claim.

**生成关系是否不可绕过 / Are generative relations indispensable? 2026-10-08:** [必要性研究](unified-2026-10-05/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md)建立完整有限端点回答中的关系可恢复性，保留整体约束对手与粗描述失败。17项新 Lean 定理、42项含继承审计通过；普遍解释优先性仍开放。 / Checked relative content necessity, with explicit representation boundaries; universal explanatory priority remains a research conjecture.

**Generative explanatory necessity, 8 October 2026.** [Ren’s research direction](15-codex-theory-conversations/2026-10-08-generative-explanatory-necessity.md) preserves the visible messages verbatim and marks assistant-origin wording. [The primary-source assessment](../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY-INTEGRATION.md#primary-sources-and-genealogy) distinguishes selected Adlam text, relation-closure antecedents and an abstract-only Lange challenge. External originals remain link-only; no empirical validation is claimed.

**Consequential differences → necessary explanatory content, 8 October 2026.** [The explanatory-necessity investigation](EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md) checks recovery of primitive transitions from exact finite endpoint answers without requiring process-shaped descriptions. Seventeen new Lean theorems / 42 total audits retain a same-content static rival, feasibility-only information loss and a global history bound that needs a richer carrier. This advances correspondence and candidate structural necessity; it does not establish universal priority, actual law formation or normative warrant. **Next:** compare independently justified global constraints with formative dependence on the same target; identify a substantive explanatory asymmetry beyond representation equivalence. / 有限查询层面的必要关系内容已实查；普遍生成必要性保持开放。

added_entries.claim_zh: 完整有限端点回答必须保留可恢复的一步变化内容；整体约束表述可保留相同答案，故内容必要性与解释优先性分开。
added_entries.claim_en: Exact finite endpoint answers retain recoverable transition content; a global-constraint presentation can preserve the same answers, separating content necessity from explanatory priority.
added_entries.scope_zh: 首轮有限查询研究完成；17项新 Lean 定理／42项含继承审计。仅可行性不足，粗配置不可组合，保留历史可恢复表示；普遍必要性、实际规律根据及唯一性未证。
added_entries.scope_en: First finite-query study complete: 17 new Lean theorems / 42 audits including imports. Feasibility-only loss and coarse-carrier failure are retained; history enrichment restores representation. Universal necessity, actual law warrant and uniqueness remain open.

added_entries.scope_zh: 17项新声明均为空公理依赖；另有25项继承审计。准确回答不被定义为充分解释；端点对应、问题范围与解读显式给定，不推出概率、干预或无限历史。
added_entries.scope_en: All 17 new declarations have empty axiom dependencies, with 25 inherited audits. Answer accuracy is not defined as sufficient explanation; endpoint correspondence, query scope and interpretation are explicit. No probability, intervention or infinite-history result.
